title: Leveraging In-Context Learning for Political Bias Testing of LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating political bias in LLMs using survey data from political candidates. While some questions (e.g., punishing criminals or wealth redistribution) touch upon socio-political values, the study's framework is specifically centered on political alignment (liberal vs. conservative) rather than benchmarking religion, faith, or specific systems of ethics and morality.
